extracted.name: Russian Quaalude
extracted.description: This tasty Russian Quaalude cocktail recipe combines half-and-half, vodka, coffee, Irish cream, and hazelnut liqueurs to create a upgraded White Russian.
ingredient_lines: 1 fluid ounce hazelnut liqueur, such as Frangelico
instruction_lines: Fill a highball glass with ice and pour in coffee liqueur, vodka, Irish cream liqueur, hazelnut liqueur, and half-and-half; stir.
